_meta.scope: DBA / assumed name / fictitious business name / trade name filing rules for SOLE PROPRIETORS trading under a name other than their own. LLC and corporation rules often differ and are not covered.
_meta.method: Started from a draft table compiled from secondary sources, then checked state by state against the statute, the agency's own page or a county .gov page (2026-10-02). `source` is the page the row was confirmed against. `verifiedOn: null` marks a row not yet confirmed.
_meta.coverage: Middesk's DBA search coverage, from source/documents/01-formation-identity.md. The search runs only when the customer submits the DBA name. Florida is on neither list.
_meta.office_and_term: `office` and `term` are written to drop into a sentence: "files {term} with {office}".

AL.name: Alabama
AL.notes: Voluntary trade name registration only; no county DBA system.

AK.name: Alaska
AK.office: the Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
AK.notes: Name registration is permissive; the trade name normally appears on the required Alaska Business License.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.ownNameRule: Any name other than the real name of the individual; no surname exception.
AR.notes: Filed in each county where business is conducted. Entities file with the Secretary of State instead.

CA.name: California
CA.ownNameRule: Fictitious if it does not include the owner's surname or suggests additional owners (Company, & Sons, Associates).
CA.notes: File within 40 days of starting business in the county of the principal place of business; publish once a week for 4 weeks.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.ownNameRule: Anything other than the owner's legal first and last name.
CO.notes: An individual's trade name lasts one year and must be renewed annually.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name; no surname exception for individuals.
CT.notes: Five-year certificates since 2025. From 2026-10-01 names are also recorded in a statewide Secretary of the State registry; filing stays with the town clerk.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.ownNameRule: Any name that does not disclose the owner's legal name.
DE.notes: Since 2026-02-02 one statewide registry at the Division of Revenue replaces the county Prothonotaries; earlier filings are in county records.

DC.name: District of Columbia
DC.office: the Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection
DC.ownNameRule: The owner's surname with one or more given names or initials; a name suggesting other parties is a trade name.
DC.notes: Renewed every two years by April 1.

FL.name: Florida
FL.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's legal name; adding any word to it requires registration.
FL.notes: Advertised once in the county of the principal place of business before registering.

GA.name: Georgia
GA.ownNameRule: Any name that does not disclose the individual ownership; the statute does not settle whether a surname is enough.
GA.notes: Filed within 30 days in the county where the business is chiefly carried on; published once a week for two weeks.

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.notes: The DCCA states sole proprietors are not required to register a trade name.

ID.name: Idaho
ID.term: a certificate of assumed business name
ID.ownNameRule: Any name that does not include the owner's full name (surname with given names or initials); a surname alone is not enough.
ID.notes: Assumed business names no longer expire.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name; no surname exception for individuals.
IL.notes: Published once a week for three weeks; the statute sets no renewal for county certificates.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.ownNameRule: A name that includes the owner's true surname is exempt.
IN.notes: Filed in each county with a place of business. Entities file with the Secretary of State.

IA.name: Iowa
IA.ownNameRule: A name that includes the owner's true surname needs no filing.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.notes: No state or county DBA registration. Local licence rules not checked.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name, which includes the surname; whether surname plus a descriptor is exempt is unsettled.
KY.notes: Filed in the county of the principal place of business. Entities file with the Secretary of State.

LA.name: Louisiana
LA.ownNameRule: Any name other than the real name of the individual.
LA.notes: Filed in each parish where business is conducted. Several secondary sources say sole proprietors need not file, confusing it with the optional state trade name registration.

ME.name: Maine
ME.ownNameRule: Anything other than the owner's own name exclusively; any addition triggers filing.
ME.notes: Filed with the clerk of the city or town where the business is carried on.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.office: the State Department of Assessments and Taxation
MD.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's own name.
MD.notes: The statute is mandatory; a Maryland Business Express preview page calls it recommended.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.ownNameRule: Any title other than the owner's real name.
MA.notes: Filed in every city or town with an office of the business.

MI.name: Michigan
MI.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name.
MI.notes: Filed in each county where business is conducted. Entities file with LARA.

MN.name: Minnesota
MN.ownNameRule: Anything other than the owner's true full first and last name.
MN.notes: Published for two successive issues; renewed every calendar year.

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.notes: The Secretary of State calls registration completely voluntary.

MO.name: Missouri
MO.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's true name.

MT.name: Montana
MT.ownNameRule: Anything other than the owner's full, true and correct name.

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.notes: Voluntary; a registered name must be published once.

NV.name: Nevada
NV.ownNameRule: Any name different in any way from the owner's legal name.
NV.notes: Expires after five years where the county has adopted an expiration ordinance.

NH.name: New Hampshire
NH.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's own name; added words ("Enterprises") trigger it.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name.
NJ.notes: Filed in each county where business is conducted. Entities file alternate names with the state.

NM.name: New Mexico
NM.notes: No state or county DBA filing found; a city business licence may ask for the trade name.

NY.name: New York
NY.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's real name.
NY.notes: Filed in each county where business is conducted.

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.ownNameRule: Any name other than a real name of the individual.
NC.notes: Filing in one county is enough; it feeds a statewide database.

ND.name: North Dakota
ND.ownNameRule: A name with the owner's surname is exempt, unless the business needs a state licence or permit.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.ownNameRule: Any name different from the owner's personal name; the statute does not define own name.
OH.notes: Either report a fictitious name or register an exclusive trade name instead.

OK.name: Oklahoma
OK.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's legal name.
OK.notes: "Shall file" covers any unincorporated business; applying it to individuals rests on the Secretary of State form. Older guides call it optional.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.ownNameRule: Any name that does not conspicuously disclose the owner's surname with given names or initials.
OR.notes: The registration lists the counties where the business operates.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's proper name; additions such as "& Sons" trigger it.
PA.notes: Published in the county of the principal place of business; no renewal since the decennial filing was repealed.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.ownNameRule: The owner's surname with a given name, middle name or initials; words suggesting other parties make it a trade name.
RI.notes: Moved from city and town clerks to the Secretary of State by 2026-01-01; renewed annually. Older filings are in municipal records.

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.notes: The state registers no DBAs; the trade name goes on the local business licence.

SD.name: South Dakota
SD.ownNameRule: A name that plainly shows the owner's true surname needs no filing.
SD.notes: May also be filed on paper with a county register of deeds.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.notes: Assumed names are for registered entities only; a sole proprietor's trade name is commonly listed on the county business tax licence.

TX.name: Texas
TX.ownNameRule: A name without the owner's surname, or one suggesting additional owners; descriptive words do not count.
TX.notes: Filed in each county with premises. The Secretary of State takes filings from entities only.

UT.name: Utah
UT.office: the Division of Corporations and Commercial Code
UT.ownNameRule: Any name different from the owner's legal name.
UT.notes: Recodified 2026-10-01 (formerly §§ 42-2-5 to 42-2-10). Requires a Utah registered agent.

VT.name: Vermont
VT.ownNameRule: A name that includes the owner's full legal name needs no filing (Secretary of State guidance).

VA.name: Virginia
VA.term: an assumed or fictitious name certificate
VA.ownNameRule: Any name other than the owner's legal name.
VA.notes: Filed with the SCC since 2020-01-01; earlier certificates are with the circuit courts.

WA.name: Washington
WA.office: the Department of Revenue Business Licensing Service
WA.ownNameRule: The statute allows the surname with other names or initials; the Department of Revenue asks for anything other than the full legal name.
WA.notes: Registered through the business licence application.

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.ownNameRule: Any assumed name; the statute does not define own name.
WV.notes: Formerly filed with the county clerk.
